# Completion certification fixture provenance

These fixtures were authored for Source Weaver certification workflow preparation.

License: MIT, matching the repository license.

Contents:

- `vmf/sourceweaver-cert-room.vmf` — synthetic Source 1 VMF text for a small sealed room with a player start, light, and landmark. It contains no proprietary map data or bundled game assets.
- `model-source/models/sourceweaver/sw_cert_cube.qc` — synthetic StudioMDL QC source.
- `model-source/models/sourceweaver/sw_cert_cube_ref.smd` — synthetic SMD reference mesh for a cube.
- `model-source/models/sourceweaver/sw_cert_cube_idle.smd` — synthetic SMD idle skeleton frame.
- `model-source/materials/models/sourceweaver/synthetic_checker.vmt` — synthetic material script text that references a placeholder texture name. No VTF texture is included.

The model source package is intended for later external StudioMDL/HLMV evidence. Compiled MDL/VVD/VTX/PHY outputs, screenshots, external binaries, Steam files, and game content must remain outside the repository unless their redistribution rights are separately recorded.
